## Weather and climate

<a id="nasa-power"></a>

### NASA POWER

`nasa-power` · Platform

Retrieve meteorological and radiation time series by coordinates, including ICASA output for the agroclimatology community.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | NASA Langley Research Center |
| Spatial coverage | Global |
| Temporal coverage | Daily data from 1981; hourly start dates vary by parameter |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Meteorology: 0.5° × 0.625°; radiation: 1° × 1° |
| Temporal resolution | Hourly, daily, monthly and climatological |
| Main variables | Air temperature; Precipitation; Relative humidity; Wind speed; Shortwave radiation; PAR (check parameter catalog) |
| Access methods | Web; REST API |
| Registration and access | **No registration**; Public queries require no account; observe request-rate and parameter-count limits. |
| Data licence | [NASA data use and citation policies](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/faqs/); Cite POWER and the underlying sources; consult the official catalog for individual parameters. |
| Applications | Crop-model weather inputs; Climate context for field experiments |
| Review status | **Documentation reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |
| Initial source groups | 01 |

**Links**: [Data Access Viewer](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/data-access-viewer/) · [Daily API](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/temporal/daily/)

**Use notes**

- Point queries represent grid cells rather than local weather-station measurements.
- ICASA output can support DSSAT; check units, day boundaries and missing values when adapting it for other models.
- The methodology page describes a native meteorological grid of 0.5° × 0.625°, while some API examples describe a 0.5° output grid; distinguish source resolution from output sampling.

**Review sources**

- [Native grids and source datasets](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/methodology/)
- [Daily coverage, ICASA format, time standards and limits](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/temporal/daily/)

<a id="open-meteo-historical"></a>

### Open-Meteo Historical Weather API

`open-meteo-historical` · Platform

Query ERA5, ERA5-Land and IFS through one interface, with VPD, reference ET and layered soil variables.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | Open-Meteo / ECMWF |
| Spatial coverage | Global |
| Temporal coverage | ERA5 from 1940; ERA5-Land from 1950; IFS from 2017 |
| Spatial resolution / depth | ERA5: 0.25°; ERA5-Land: 0.1°; IFS: 9 km |
| Temporal resolution | Hourly; daily aggregations available |
| Main variables | Air temperature; Precipitation; VPD; FAO-56 reference ET; Layered soil temperature and moisture to 255 cm |
| Access methods | REST API; CSV; XLSX |
| Registration and access | **No registration**; The free noncommercial API requires no key and has usage limits; commercial and high-volume services have separate plans. |
| Data licence | [CC BY 4.0 for data; separate service terms](https://open-meteo.com/en/terms); Distinguish the data licence from the noncommercial restriction on the free API service. |
| Applications | Drought and heat-stress assessment; Growing degree days and yield-model features |
| Review status | **Documentation reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |
| Initial source groups | 02 |

**Links**: [Documentation and query builder](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api) · [Service terms](https://open-meteo.com/en/terms)

**Use notes**

- Use a fixed ERA5 or ERA5-Land configuration for long-term comparisons; Best Match combines sources.
- Available variables differ by model; historical variables do not all have 9 km resolution.

**Review sources**

- [Model coverage, resolution and variables](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api)
- [Data licence and noncommercial API limits](https://open-meteo.com/en/terms)

## Soil properties

<a id="soilgrids"></a>

### SoilGrids 2.0

`soilgrids` · Dataset

Machine-learning maps of soil properties and prediction uncertainty for baseline soil information.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | ISRIC – World Soil Information |
| Spatial coverage | Global land |
| Temporal coverage | Static spatial predictions; not an annual time series |
| Spatial resolution / depth | 250 m; six standard depth intervals within 0–200 cm |
| Temporal resolution | Static |
| Main variables | Soil organic carbon; Total nitrogen; pH; Bulk density; CEC; Sand, silt and clay fractions |
| Access methods | WebDAV; WCS; WMS |
| Registration and access | **No registration**; Maps and files are public. The documentation currently reports a paused REST API; consider WCS or WebDAV. |
| Data licence | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); Cite the SoilGrids version and methodology paper. |
| Applications | Crop and nutrient-model initialization; Spatial soil-carbon analysis |
| Review status | **Documentation reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |
| Initial source groups | 03 |

**Links**: [Map viewer](https://soilgrids.org/) · [Official documentation](https://docs.isric.org/globaldata/soilgrids/) · [File service](https://files.isric.org/soilgrids/)

**Use notes**

- Grid predictions are not field-profile measurements; use the prediction intervals.
- Field capacity and wilting point require a specific hydraulic product, pressure definition and derivation method; do not infer availability from the core property list.

**Review sources**

- [Properties, six depth intervals, licence and REST API pause](https://docs.isric.org/globaldata/soilgrids/)

## Flux observations and near-surface phenology

<a id="ameriflux"></a>

### AmeriFlux

`ameriflux` · Observation network

BASE data and AmeriFlux FLUXNET products with gap filling and flux partitioning.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | AmeriFlux Management Project / site teams |
| Spatial coverage | Ecosystem sites across the Americas; filter for cropland |
| Temporal coverage | Start and end dates vary by site |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Flux-tower footprint |
| Temporal resolution | Half-hourly or hourly; derived aggregations |
| Main variables | NEE; Latent and sensible heat; Meteorology; GPP / RECO, depending on product |
| Access methods | Web; Site-level downloads |
| Registration and access | **Account required**; A free account and a description of intended use are required to download data. |
| Data licence | [CC BY 4.0 or AmeriFlux Legacy](https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/data/data-policy/); Check the policy for every site and cite its DOI; mixed analyses involving Legacy data must follow the applicable Legacy policy. |
| Applications | Carbon and water-flux evaluation; Agroecosystem process studies |
| Review status | **Documentation reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |
| Initial source groups | 04 |

**Links**: [Download data](https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/data/download-data/) · [Product documentation](https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/data/aboutdata/)

**Use notes**

- Cropland site counts and usable years require current filtering; network totals are not cropland sample counts.
- GPP is partitioned; ET is often converted from latent heat. Check quality flags, energy balance and footprint representativeness.

**Review sources**

- [Account requirement and BASE/FLUXNET differences](https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/data/aboutdata/)
- [CC BY and Legacy policies](https://ameriflux.lbl.gov/data/data-policy/)

<a id="fluxnet"></a>

### FLUXNET / FLUXNET Shuttle

`fluxnet` · Observation network

Use Shuttle for evolving cross-network flux products, with separate access to historical products such as FLUXNET2015.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | FLUXNET partner networks / site teams |
| Spatial coverage | Global sites; not a regular global raster |
| Temporal coverage | Site- and product-dependent; distinguish historical and current systems |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Flux-tower footprint |
| Temporal resolution | Half-hourly and aggregated products, depending on dataset |
| Main variables | CO₂ fluxes; Water and heat fluxes; Meteorology; GPP, depending on processing |
| Access methods | Shuttle Web; Shuttle tools; Historical product portals |
| Registration and access | **Function/product-specific**; Account requirements and workflows differ between Shuttle and historical products; confirm the target product. |
| Data licence | [Site- and product-specific licences](https://fluxnet.org/download-data/); Save site DOIs, versions and licences; a platform citation does not replace dataset citations. |
| Applications | Satellite carbon and water-flux evaluation; Cross-ecosystem comparisons |
| Review status | **Partially reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Migration guidance reviewed; historical-product login workflows and all site licences have not been individually checked. |
| Initial source groups | 04 |

**Links**: [Shuttle portal](https://data.fluxnet.org/) · [Official access guidance](https://fluxnet.org/download-data/) · [Originally supplied URL](https://fluxnet.org/data/download-data/)

**Use notes**

- Check processing versions before combining historical and new products.
- The network is not exclusively cropland; processed fluxes have uncertainty.

**Review sources**

- [Download migration to Shuttle and separate historical access](https://fluxnet.org/download-data/)

<a id="phenocam"></a>

### PhenoCam

`phenocam` · Observation network

Camera imagery and region-of-interest greenness time series for vegetation seasonality.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | PhenoCam Network / site teams |
| Spatial coverage | Global site network; filter by crop and site |
| Temporal coverage | Site- and release-dependent |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Camera field of view / region of interest |
| Temporal resolution | Often half-hourly images with daily derived products |
| Main variables | RGB imagery; GCC; Green-up and green-down transition dates |
| Access methods | Web; Image and time-series files |
| Registration and access | **No registration**; Public browsing and product access; the site table returned HTTP 403 during this review, and not all download routes were tested. |
| Data licence | [PhenoCam Fair Use / release-specific terms](https://phenocam.nau.edu/webcam/fairuse_statement/); Check the licence for images and derived products and the required site citations. |
| Applications | Satellite phenology evaluation; Seasonal canopy dynamics |
| Review status | **Partially reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official access-guide index reviewed. The site table returned 403; current site counts, crop counts and release-specific licences remain unchecked. |
| Initial source groups | 08 |

**Links**: [Site table](https://phenocam.nau.edu/webcam/network/table/) · [Official access guide](https://phenocam.nau.edu/education/PhenoCam_Access_Guide.pdf)

**Use notes**

- The supplied counts of 1,086 total sites and 249 crop/orchard sites were not verified.
- GCC and transition dates depend on the ROI, illumination and algorithm thresholds; they are not direct measurements of crop developmental stages.

**Review sources**

- [Official guide index describes GCC, transition dates, downloads and Fair Use](https://phenocam.nau.edu/education/PhenoCam_Access_Guide.pdf)

## Satellite remote sensing and cloud platforms

<a id="planetary-computer"></a>

### Microsoft Planetary Computer

`planetary-computer` · Platform

Discover remote-sensing rasters through STAC and read cloud-hosted assets on demand.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | Microsoft / original data providers |
| Spatial coverage | Global and regional collections |
| Temporal coverage | Collection- and mission-dependent |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Product-dependent; Sentinel-2: 10–60 m; HLS: 30 m, for example |
| Temporal resolution | Acquisitions and compositing intervals vary |
| Main variables | Sentinel-2 reflectance; Landsat; Sentinel-1 SAR; HLS |
| Access methods | STAC API; COG / cloud object storage |
| Registration and access | **Function/product-specific**; The catalog is public; some assets require temporary SAS signing. Compute environments and resources have their own conditions. |
| Data licence | [Original collection licences](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/catalog); Check the STAC/API conditions and the underlying dataset licence separately. |
| Applications | Field-scale remote-sensing time series; Red-edge and SAR features |
| Review status | **Partially reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official catalog index checked; access/signing documentation returned a JavaScript shell, and asset retrieval was not tested end to end. |
| Initial source groups | 05 |

**Links**: [Data catalog](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/catalog) · [SAS access documentation](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/docs/concepts/sas/)

**Use notes**

- Discovery and data access do not automatically perform clipping, cloud masking or index calculation; those require user code or a suitable service.
- HLS acquisition frequency does not guarantee an uninterrupted cloud-free record for every field.

**Review sources**

- [Official indexed catalog lists HLS, Sentinel and Landsat collections](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/catalog)
- [Access-mechanism documentation; its body required JavaScript during this review](https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/docs/concepts/sas/)

<a id="google-earth-engine"></a>

### Google Earth Engine

`google-earth-engine` · Platform

Cloud geospatial computing with collections including Landsat, Sentinel, MODIS, SMAP and GEDI.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | Google / individual data providers |
| Spatial coverage | Global and regional datasets |
| Temporal coverage | Collection-dependent; no shared 1972 start date for every product |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Product-dependent; no single 10 m or 30 m resolution |
| Temporal resolution | Product-dependent |
| Main variables | Reflectance; Vegetation indices; Land surface temperature; Soil moisture; Canopy structure; Crop classifications |
| Access methods | JavaScript; Python API; Code Editor |
| Registration and access | **Account required**; Requires a Google account, a registered Cloud project and an enabled API. Free noncommercial use requires eligibility verification and is subject to quotas. |
| Data licence | [Platform terms and individual dataset licences](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets); Dataset licences vary; commercial platform services have separate pricing. |
| Applications | Large-area crop mapping; Multisource spatial and temporal features |
| Review status | **Documentation reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |
| Initial source groups | 06 |

**Links**: [Data catalog](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets) · [Platform](https://earthengine.google.com/) · [Access and eligibility](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/guides/access)

**Use notes**

- Check mission start dates, collection versions and band resolutions separately.
- Root-zone SMAP moisture requires the relevant assimilation/model product; it is not a property of every SMAP dataset.

**Review sources**

- [Accounts, projects, noncommercial verification and commercial registration](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/guides/access)
- [Official collection catalog](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets)

<a id="nasa-appeears"></a>

### NASA AppEEARS

`nasa-appeears` · Platform

Subset data and quality information by points, polygons, time periods and layers.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | NASA Earthdata / LP DAAC and partner archives |
| Spatial coverage | Product-dependent; EMIT and ECOSTRESS are not seamless continuous global products |
| Temporal coverage | Mission-dependent; no common continuous coverage from 2000 |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Product-dependent; HLS: 30 m; ECOSTRESS: about 70 m; EMIT: about 60 m |

| Main variables | Reflectance; Evapotranspiration; Land surface temperature; Vegetation indices; Quality flags |

| Data licence | [Product-specific Earthdata use policies](https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/); Cite the actual product version and DOI and follow the provider’s attribution requirements. |
| Applications | Remote-sensing extraction for experiment sites; Multifield time-series preparation |
| Review status | **Documentation reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |
| Initial source groups | 07 |

**Links**: [Extraction portal](https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/) · [Products and changelog](https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/changelog)

**Use notes**

- The product list changes. HLS reflectance may still require index calculation by the user.
- Retain quality information and check current output-format and EMIT task-combination constraints.

**Review sources**

- [Point/area sampling and quality outputs](https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/)
- [EMIT, HLS and ECOSTRESS support and changes](https://appeears.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov/changelog)

## Crop maps, yield and agricultural statistics

<a id="usda-quickstats"></a>

### USDA NASS Quick Stats

`usda-quickstats` · Platform

Query production, yield, area and survey statistics by crop, place, year and indicator.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service |
| Spatial coverage | United States; national, state, county and other levels vary by indicator |
| Temporal coverage | Historical coverage varies by crop, place and indicator |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Administrative statistical units, not pixels |
| Temporal resolution | Annual, weekly or other survey intervals |
| Main variables | Production; Yield; Area; Crop progress |
| Access methods | Web queries; CSV; API |
| Registration and access | **Function/product-specific**; Web queries are public; programmatic API access requires a requested key. |
| Data licence | [USDA public data / metadata-specific terms](https://www.nass.usda.gov/About_NASS/Policies_and_Notices/); Cite NASS, the indicator, geography, years and query date; check third-party exceptions. |
| Applications | Administrative-scale yield evaluation; Historical crop trends |
| Review status | **Partially reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Query interface checked; API-key workflow, individual indicator coverage and reuse terms have not all been tested. |
| Initial source groups | 09 |

**Links**: [Query tool](https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/) · [API](https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api)

**Use notes**

- Do not assume every county has a complete record starting in 1866.
- Suppressed or missing markers such as (D) are not zero; check boundary, survey-definition and unit changes.

**Review sources**

- [Official What/Where/When query and geography selection](https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/)
- [API registration entry; keyed calls were not tested](https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api)

| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |

## Water resources and water productivity

<a id="fao-wapor"></a>

### FAO WaPOR v3

`fao-wapor` · Platform

Remote-sensing estimates of evapotranspiration, productivity, land cover and water productivity.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | FAO |
| Spatial coverage | Global Level I; selected regions at Levels II and III |
| Temporal coverage | Check version, level and layer |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Level I: 300 m; Level II: 100 m; Level III: 20 m |
| Temporal resolution | Layer-dependent: dekadal, monthly, seasonal, annual and others |
| Main variables | AETI; NPP; Biomass; Reference evapotranspiration; Water productivity |
| Access methods | Web; Raster downloads; FAO API |
| Registration and access | **Function/product-specific**; The catalog is publicly discoverable; confirm export and API authentication for the current portal and layer. |
| Data licence | [CC BY 4.0 with FAO database terms](https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/); WaPOR is listed under FAO’s database policy; check individual layers and third-party exceptions. |
| Applications | Irrigation water-use assessment; Agricultural water productivity |
| Review status | **Partially reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Product documentation and licence reviewed; individual export routes and API authentication have not been tested end to end. |
| Initial source groups | 10 |

**Links**: [Portal](https://data.apps.fao.org/wapor/) · [Product levels](https://www.fao.org/in-action/remote-sensing-for-water-productivity/wapor-data/en)

**Use notes**

- 20 m coverage is limited to selected irrigation schemes and basins.
- AETI, NPP and water productivity are derived products; NPP is not economic crop yield, and product definitions do not cover every WUE metric.

## Biodiversity and crop pests

<a id="gbif-occurrence"></a>

### GBIF Occurrence

`gbif-occurrence` · Platform

Species occurrence records with taxonomic, spatial, temporal and source information, searchable for crop pests and weeds.

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | GBIF / publishing institutions |
| Spatial coverage | Global; uneven sampling and georeferencing |
| Temporal coverage | Species-, publisher- and record-dependent |
| Spatial resolution / depth | Point records with variable coordinate precision |
| Temporal resolution | Observation or collection event dates |
| Main variables | Species names; Coordinates where available; Dates; Basis of record; Coordinate uncertainty |
| Access methods | Web search; Occurrence API; Asynchronous downloads |
| Registration and access | **Function/product-specific**; Search is public; formal bulk-download requests require a free account and authentication and receive a download DOI. |
| Data licence | [CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-NC, by source dataset](https://www.gbif.org/terms); Filter and retain source licences and download DOIs; check NC restrictions for commercial use. |
| Applications | Potential pest distributions; Biodiversity mapping |
| Review status | **Documentation reviewed** · 2026-10-15 |
| Review scope | Official documentation or release metadata reviewed; complete data files have not been downloaded or independently validated. |
| Initial source groups | 11 |

**Links**: [Occurrence search](https://www.gbif.org/occurrence/search) · [Download API](https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/data-use/api-downloads)

**Use notes**

- Records include specimens and observations; not every record has reliable GPS coordinates or represents a wild living organism.
- Address synonyms, sampling bias, duplicates, captive/cultivated records and coordinate errors/uncertainty. Occurrences do not directly measure pest density or outbreaks.

**Review sources**

- [Authentication, download requests and DOIs](https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/data-use/api-downloads)
- [Licence combinations and coordinate-quality filters](https://techdocs.gbif.org/en/data-use/b-cubed/generate-cube-databricks)
